permissionSets.name: AdministratorAccess
permissionSets.description: Full access to the account. For account administration and break-glass use.

permissionSets.name: PlatformOpsAccess
permissionSets.description: Platform team: every service including IAM. No access keys or console passwords, no changes to the Identity Center or organization access roles, no stopping CloudTrail, no long-term purchases.

permissionSets.name: DeveloperFullAccess
permissionSets.description: Developers: every service; IAM is read-only. Can pass any role except the organization, platform and deploy roles. Cannot turn off security tooling or change Identity Center. No long-term purchases.

permissionSets.name: DeveloperReadOnly
permissionSets.description: Developers: read-only access to every service, logs included. No secret values.

permissionSets.name: BillingManagement
permissionSets.description: Billing, payments, budgets and cost reports, and a read-only view of the organization's accounts.
